name: SupportConversation
description: Server-only bounded Help Desk conversation mapping for administrator support review

conversation_token.description: Opaque server-generated continuation token safe for the current visitor session

provider_conversation_id.description: Private provider conversation identifier never returned to browsers or administrators

owner_user_id.description: Authenticated platform user id when the visitor is signed in

owner_email.description: Normalized authenticated account email when available

visitor_name.description: Bounded visitor name collected only when available or requested for support

visitor_email.description: Bounded visitor email collected only when available or requested for support

status.description: Conversation status: OPEN, HUMAN_REQUESTED, or RESOLVED

human_requested.description: Whether this conversation has an explicit human support request

human_requested_at.description: Server timestamp when human help was requested

human_support_request_id.description: Linked HumanSupportRequest id when a handoff exists

started_at.description: Server timestamp when the conversation began

last_message_at.description: Server timestamp of the latest stored message

message_count.description: Bounded count of stored user and assistant messages

last_message_preview.description: Bounded preview of the latest user or assistant message
